# Order Payment

## Overview

OrderHub provides several ways to collect and record payments against orders. You can accept **Cash**, use **Offline Merchant Services** (such as a standalone card machine), or process payments through **Integrated Hardware Terminals** connected directly to OrderHub.

Payment collection is available from the order detail view – click the **Collect Payment** button on any unpaid order or by clicking on the Credit Card Icon.

![Credit Card Icon](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/99a8e582-ce5c-4ce6-ac41-b001576e588b.png)

---

## Cash Payments

To record a cash payment:

1. Open the order and click **Collect Payment**.
2. Select **Cash** as the payment method.
3. Enter the **amount received** and an optional **reference** (e.g. "Exact change" or a till reference).
4. Confirm the payment.

The order is immediately marked as paid and the payment date is recorded.

---

## Offline Merchant Services

If your business uses a standalone card machine or other payment method that is not integrated with OrderHub, you can set up **Offline Merchant Services** to record these transactions.

![Order Payment Options](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/cda297a4-5217-4913-8140-d877c1206aa4.png)

### Setting Up Payment Methods

1. Navigate to **Settings → Payments**.
2. Under **Manual Payment Methods**, click **Add Payment Method**.
3. Enter a name for the method, e.g. "Card Machine", "Bank Transfer", or "PayPal".
4. Save the method. It will now appear as an option when collecting payment.

You can add as many offline methods as you need. Each one can be renamed or removed at any time from the Payments settings tab.

You can Re-Order these by dragging and dropping around the above below each other. The order shown in the admin interface dictates the order in which they are shown when Order Payment Method is taken.

![Setting up order Payments](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/60d333c0-a70c-4e95-9e06-58e15bd9f99a.png)

### Recording an Offline Payment

1. Open the order and click **Collect Payment**.
2. Select the offline payment method from the list.
3. Enter the **amount**, **payment date**, and an optional **reference** (e.g. a transaction ID from your card machine receipt).
4. Confirm the payment.

The order is marked as paid with the chosen method and reference stored against it.

![Order Payment Details Recording](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/11468d5e-41af-43a8-9cd3-c506ae2404d2.png)

## Integrated Hardware Terminals

For a fully connected payment experience, OrderHub supports integrated hardware terminals from supported providers. When configured, you can send a payment request directly to a physical card reader from within OrderHub and the order is automatically marked as paid once the customer completes the transaction.

### How It Works

1. Open the order and click **Collect Payment**.
2. If integrated terminals are configured for the order's pickup location, select the terminal from the list.
3. Click **Start Payment Collection** – the payment amount is sent to the terminal device.
4. The customer taps, inserts, or swipes their card on the terminal.
5. Once approved, OrderHub automatically marks the order as paid. No manual entry is required.

If the payment is declined or cancelled, you can retry from the same screen.

### Terminal Configuration

Terminals are configured per **store location**. Each location can have multiple terminals from different providers. Terminal setup is managed under **Settings → Locations** – select a location and configure its payment terminals.

> **Note**: For detailed setup guides on each supported terminal provider (Stripe, Helcim, and Gravity Payments), see the dedicated help articles for each integration.

---

## Payment History

Once an order is marked as paid, the payment details are visible on the order:

- **Payment method** – Cash, the offline method name, or the terminal provider
- **Payment reference** – any reference number or transaction ID
- **Payment date** – when the payment was recorded or confirmed

---

## Tips

- Only unpaid orders show the **Collect Payment** button.
- If an order has already been paid, the payment details are displayed in the order summary.
- Payment collection is available to users with **Admin** or **Staff** roles.
- The payment date field respects your organisation's date format preference.
